# Thunderbird keyboard-shortcut source documentation

Capture platform behavior explicitly: `accel` maps Meta on macOS and Control elsewhere; Spaces numbering, compose keyup behavior, native GTK/Cocoa, PDF/editor, and DevTools bindings can differ. Final files are `mail/base/docs/1_keyboard_shortcuts.md` through `4_keyboard_shortcuts_shared.md`, indexed under `/frontend/1_keyboard_shortcuts`. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
